mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in periods of significant UNRATE decrease.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of significant RSAFS decrease.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in periods of significant INDPRO increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of low FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in periods of sustained PAYEMS increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month indicates weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of significant HOUST decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a tightening monetary policy and a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy and strong economy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in periods of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE.
